items.observation: The result of `completer.future.whenComplete(...)` is discarded. If a blocked select ends with an error (the onSend branch on a channel that closes while waiting: 310-314, or an assigned handler/timeout handler: 386-389, 398) the derived future carries the same error with no listener and is reported to the zone as an uncaught error in addition to the error sent to the caller. There is no test for the error path of a blocked select. Found by reading the code; not reproduced by a run.
items.proposed_fix: Use `completer.future.whenComplete(cleanup).ignore()` (supported by sdk ^3.6) or do the cleanup on the resolve/timer paths; add a contract test: a blocked select on onSend, then close → select throwsStateError and no uncaught error.
items.closure_criteria: The blocked select cleanup leaves no derived future without a listener, either through ignore() or by running the cleanup on the resolve and timer paths. The new contract test closes a channel under a blocked onSend select, expects throwsStateError and reports no uncaught error.

items.observation: The child token attaches to the parent with `parent.whenCancelled.then(...)` and never detaches. A long-lived parent that is never cancelled (process root token + per-request `withTaskScope(parent:)`) holds a closure and the child token forever for every child. Found by reading; not measured.
items.proposed_fix: Build a cancel-listener list (add/remove) in CancelToken; have withTaskScope/withTimeout detach the child from the parent in `finally`; add a test that measures the listener count across many short scopes.
items.closure_criteria: CancelToken removes each child listener when withTaskScope or withTimeout finishes. The new test shows the listener count staying flat across many short scopes under one parent.

items.observation: The warning 'do not keep a reference to the Scope outside body' is not enforced: after drain finishes, `spawn` starts an untracked task; its error is written to `_error`, which nobody reads, and is swallowed.
items.proposed_fix: A `_closed` flag after drain; `spawn` on a closed scope should throw StateError; add a test.
items.closure_criteria: A drained scope sets a _closed flag and spawn on it throws StateError. The new scope test passes.

items.observation: capacity is checked only with an assert; in a release build a negative capacity silently behaves like an unbuffered channel.
items.proposed_fix: `ArgumentError.value(capacity, 'capacity', 'must not be negative')` + a test (not a contract change, undocumented input).
items.closure_criteria: The Channel constructor raises ArgumentError.value for a negative capacity in a release build. The new argument test passes.

items.observation: `catch (error, stack)` has no `on` and no rethrow (the error is thrown again later with Error.throwWithStackTrace).
items.proposed_fix: `on Object catch (error, stack)` + a short rationale comment.
items.closure_criteria: scope.dart uses on Object catch with a short rationale comment and still rethrows through Error.throwWithStackTrace.

items.observation: An untouched `dart create` template, recommended only. Sibling packages enable strict-casts/inference/raw-types and public_member_api_docs. Undocumented public constructors: `CancelledException([this.reason])`, `ChannelClosedError()`.
items.proposed_fix: Adopt the resilience analysis set and close the findings in the same change.
items.closure_criteria: analysis_options.yaml carries the strict set used by resilience and both exception constructors have dartdoc. dart analyze is clean.

items.observation: The public changelog names an internal tool path and a private repository ('`tools/term-trailer.sh` in the portfolio repository'). Public text must not mention internal process names; it is also published on pub.dev.
items.proposed_fix: Rewrite the line without the internal name in the next release (for example a script that produces the frames from a real run); the published 1.1.1 archive does not change, accept that.
items.closure_criteria: The next release CHANGELOG describes the frame source without naming tools/term-trailer.sh or the portfolio repository.
